item.title: No-barrier shelter is actually getting in the way
item.description: Cities across the state are trying to develop strategies for dealing with a growing homelessness problem. Even small towns in the most rural parts of West Virginia have reported an uptick in homelessness and the problems that are associated with it. Non-profit organizations and volunteers often lead the charge to provide critical housing and services. The post No-barrier shelter is actually getting in the way appeared first on WV MetroNews.
